1.选取MajorAxisLength和MinorAxisLength两个特征和前3349组数据，绘制散点图
```{r}
library(MASS)  
library(pROC)  
library(klaR)
library(e1071)
set.seed(2024)
df <- read.csv("C:/Users/42840/Desktop/Dry_Bean_Dataset.csv") 
data1select <- df[1:3349, c("MajorAxisLength", "MinorAxisLength")] 
plot(data1select$MajorAxisLength,data1select$MinorAxisLength)
```


2.使用随机数set.seed(2024)构造一个包含0.7n个样本的训练集和一个包含0.3n个样本的测试集，通过MASS包中的lda()函数拟合LDA
```{r}
set.seed(2024)


data1select <- df[1:3349, c("MajorAxisLength", "MinorAxisLength", "Class")]
data1select$Class <- as.factor(data1select$Class)  
set.seed(2024)
train_indices <- sample(1:nrow(data1select), 0.7 * nrow(data1select))
trainset <- data1select[train_indices, ]
testset <- data1select[-train_indices, ]

ldafit <- lda(Class ~ MajorAxisLength + MinorAxisLength,trainset) 
summary(ldafit)
```



3.通过predict()函数计算LDA在测试集上的混淆矩阵和整体准确率
```{r}
prediction1 <- predict(ldafit, newdata = testset)  
  
table(testset$Class, prediction1$class)

hxmatrix <- table(testset$Class, prediction1$class)  

zql <- sum(diag(hxmatrix) / sum(hxmatrix)) 

zql
```

4.通过pROC包中的roc()函数绘制LDA在测试集上的ROC曲线并计算AUC
```{r}
roclda <- roc(testset$Class, as.numeric(prediction1$class))  
plot(roclda, col=9, main="LDA", print.auc=TRUE)  
```

5.通过klaR包中的partimat()函数绘制LDA的分类边界
```{r}
  
partimat(Class ~ MajorAxisLength + MinorAxisLength, data = trainset, method = "lda")
```

6.通过MASS包中的qda()函数拟合QDA，并重复3-5中的工作（总图见后文8.2）
```{r}
qdafit <- qda(Class ~ MajorAxisLength + MinorAxisLength, data = trainset)  
prediction2 <- predict(qdafit, newdata = testset) 
table(testset$Class, prediction2$class)

hxmatrix2 <- table(testset$Class, prediction2$class)  

zql2 <- sum(diag(hxmatrix2) / sum(hxmatrix2)) 

zql2

rocqda <- roc(testset$Class, as.numeric(prediction2$class))  
plot(rocqda, col=12, main="QDA", print.auc=TRUE)


```

7.通过e1071包中的naiveBayes()函数拟合朴素贝叶斯，并重复3-5中的工作（总图见后文8.2）
```{r}
nfit <- naiveBayes(Class ~ MajorAxisLength + MinorAxisLength, data = trainset)  
prediction3 <- predict(nfit, newdata = testset, type = "class")  
table(testset$Class, prediction3)
matrix3 <- table(testset$Class, prediction3)  
nzql <- sum(diag(matrix3)) / sum(matrix3)  
nzql

npred <- predict(nfit, newdata = testset, type = "raw")  
rocn <- roc(testset$Class, as.numeric(npred[,2])) 

plot(rocn, col=5, main="naiveBayes", print.auc=TRUE)
```


8.通过glm()函数拟合逻辑回归并重复3-5中的工作
```{r}
glmfit <- glm(Class ~ MajorAxisLength + MinorAxisLength, family = binomial, data = trainset)

prediction4 <- predict(glmfit, newdata = testset)

table(testset$Class, prediction4 > 0.5)
matrix4 <- table(testset$Class, prediction4 > 0.5)

glmzql <- sum(diag(matrix4)) / sum(matrix4)
glmzql

rocglm <- roc(testset$Class,prediction4)

plot(rocglm, col=3, main="GLM", print.auc=TRUE)
```


8.2将LDA，QDA，朴素贝叶斯与逻辑回归的ROC曲线绘制在同一张图中并比较
```{r}
plot(roclda, col = 1)
lines(rocqda, col = 2)
lines(rocn, col = 3)
lines(rocglm, col = 4)
legend("bottomright", legend = c("LDA", "QDA", "NaiveBayes", "Regression"),
       col = c(1, 2, 3, 4), lwd = 2)
```

9.编写梯度下降算法来实现逻辑回归，将结果与glm()函数拟合的结果比较
```{r}
descent <- function(X, y, lr = 0.01, max_iter = 1000) {
  X <- as.matrix(cbind(1, X)) 
  y <- as.matrix(y)
  theta <- matrix(0, nrow = ncol(X), ncol = 1)
  for (i in 1:max_iter) {
    predictions <- 1 / (1 + exp(-X %*% theta))
    errors <- y - predictions
    theta <- theta + lr * t(X) %*% errors
  }
  return(theta)
}
trainX <- trainset[, c("MajorAxisLength", "MinorAxisLength")]
trainy <- ifelse(trainset$Class == levels(trainset$Class)[1], 1, 0) 
gd_theta <- descent(trainX, trainy)
print(gd_theta)

print(coef(glmfit))
```
